body: Glean co-founder and CTO T.R. Vishwanath discusses customer control of data and Glean’s work with OpenAI on the Private Safety Processing preview. Learn more about OpenAI Private Intelligence: https://openai.com/business/private-intelligence/
ar_body: يتحدث T.R. Vishwanath، المؤسس المشارك لـ Glean، عن تحكم العملاء ببياناتهم وتعاون الشركة مع OpenAI في معاينة Private Safety Processing.
